summary: Meme Search is an AI-driven search engine that indexes image collections using vision-language models and vector embeddings. It automatically generates text descriptions from images to enable both semantic and keyword-based retrieval.
goodFor: It is suited for individuals or teams with large, unorganised image collections who need to retrieve specific files using natural language queries.
watchOut: Running vision-language models and generating vector embeddings locally will require significant computational resources, likely demanding a dedicated GPU for acceptable performance.
deployNotes: As a Docker-based deployment, you will typically need to map persistent volumes for the image library and vector database, alongside configuring a reverse proxy for HTTPS.
